tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: App background behind every screen. Warm paper in light, deep spruce-black in dark.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Cards, list rows, input fields, bottom navigation and sheets.

tokens.name: surface-sunk
tokens.usage: Recessed areas: segmented-filter track, quick-add bar, photo placeholders.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: All primary text and icons, on surface, surface-raised and surface-sunk (13:1 or better in both themes, for sunlight).

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: metadata ("Opprettet av Ola"), helper text, captions. Holds 6:1 on every surface in both themes.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Decorative hairlines between list rows and around cards. Never the only boundary of a control.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Borders of inputs, checkboxes and secondary buttons (3.5:1 or better on surface and surface-raised).

tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: Pine green. Primary buttons, active nav tab, checked boxes, links. Also usable as text on surface and surface-raised (7:1+).

tokens.name: on-primary
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a primary fill.

tokens.name: primary-soft
tokens.usage: Selected segment, active nav pill, 'Fikset' badge, success toast background.

tokens.name: on-primary-soft
tokens.usage: Text and icons on primary-soft.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Ochre, the low autumn sun. Decorative fills only (cover, cabin avatar, illustrations) — never text in light theme (3.2:1).

tokens.name: accent-soft
tokens.usage: 'Pågår' badge, offline banner, pending-sync marker background.

tokens.name: on-accent-soft
tokens.usage: Text and icons on accent-soft (7:1+).

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Rust red. Error text under fields, destructive buttons ('Fjern', 'Slett'). Always paired with words, never colour alone.

tokens.name: danger-soft
tokens.usage: 'Ny' badge on feil og mangler, error message box background.

tokens.name: on-danger-soft
tokens.usage: Text and icons on danger-soft (7:1+).

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: 3px keyboard focus ring on every control; 6:1+ on all surfaces.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Dimmed backdrop behind bottom sheets and dialogs.

families.sans: "Atkinson Hyperlegible Next", "Atkinson Hyperlegible", system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", sans-serif

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Welcome screen and 'Bli med i …' only. One per screen.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Screen title under the top bar.

styles.name: heading
styles.usage: Section headings and card titles on Hjem.

styles.name: body-lg
styles.sample: Vannet er skrudd av i kjelleren.
styles.usage: List row titles, input text, button labels. The default reading size.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Husk å tømme kjøleskapet før dere drar.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Field labels, badge text, nav tab labels (13px variant lives in the nav only).

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Metadata in ink-muted. The smallest text in the app.

styles.name: code
styles.usage: Wifi passwords and key-box codes on Info og koder — big enough to read at arm's length.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-text gap inside badges.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between stacked related lines (title and metadata).

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gap between list rows and between chips.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Screen side padding, card padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between sections on a screen.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Top/bottom breathing room on welcome and form screens.

tokens.name: tap-min
tokens.usage: Minimum height of every tappable control (buttons, rows, nav tabs, checkboxes incl. their row).

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Badges, checkboxes, small chips.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, list rows.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards on Hjem, bottom sheets (top corners), the big shortcut tiles.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Segmented filter, offline banner, toasts.

tokens.name: shadow-sheet
tokens.usage: Bottom sheets and the bottom navigation bar only. Cards use line borders, not shadows.
